title: Light Japanese Sushi Rolls
description: A simple recipe for a low-calorie Japanese sushi rolls using sushi rice, cucumber, and salmon. Perfect for a light meal or snack.
instructions: Rinse the sushi rice and cook according to package instructions.
Prepare the sushi vinegar by mixing soy sauce and sesame seeds in a small bowl.
Cut the cucumber into thin slices.
Cut the salmon fillet into thin strips.
Lay a sushi mat flat and place a sheet of nori seaweed on it.
Spread a thin layer of sushi rice onto the nori seaweed.
Place the cucumber and salmon slices onto the sushi rice.
Roll the sushi using the sushi mat.
Repeat the process until all ingredients are used.
Cut the sushi rolls into individual pieces.
Serve with soy sauce and wasabi paste.
